headline: Wholesale turnover in August hits record NT$1.8501 trillion; ministry estimates September will break NT$2 trillion for the first time
summary: Taiwan's wholesale turnover reached a record NT$1.8501 trillion in August, up 65.4% year on year. The ministry estimates September will break NT$2 trillion for the first time.
why: Wholesale turnover is a leading gauge of trade and domestic demand, important for Taiwan's supply chains and export-oriented economy.
